notes.title: Lucky Dog 1 update
notes.content: [p]We've released a patch that fixes the following:[/p][list][*][p]Typos[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 100% completion CGs not being unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some system images missing transparency data[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed looping sound effect[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed misaligned morgue route choice[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed error message when LuckyPoint is negative[/p][/*][/list][p]All files in this update will be automatically distributed to all Steam users.[/p]
